1. SELECT a.asset_name, at.type_name  
   FROM assets a  
   JOIN asset_types at ON a.asset_type_id = at.asset_type_id  
   JOIN locations l ON a.location_id = l.location_id  
   WHERE l.location_name = 'Harbor Tap'  
   ORDER BY a.asset_name;

2. SELECT a.asset_name, at.type_name  
   FROM locations l  
   JOIN assets a ON l.location_id = a.location_id  
   JOIN asset_types at ON a.asset_type_id = at.asset_type_id  
   WHERE l.location_name = 'Harbor Tap'  
   ORDER BY at.type_name, a.asset_name;
